lines: The Gosha Public Order Unit had departed from school to investigate the serial killing case.
Taking the front of the pack was the commander, Nao-senpai.
The quiet Koro-senpai was walking alongside her.
And Hebiko, a short way behind them.
Those were the Gosha Public Order Unit's regular members.
And a temporary member...... which was to say, me, after I had been inducted today against my will, was walking at a fair distance behind the three of them.
Frankly, I wanted to just run away.
Seeming to have sensed that feeling, Hebiko stopped walking briefly and fell into line with me.
「Well, I got forcibly dragged along by Nao-senpai, telling me she was going to test out my ability.」
She laughed amusedly, and whispered into my ear so that it wouldn't be audible to the two in front.
「Nao-senpai is interested in Fuuma-chan. You know, because of the new unit commander thing.」
「I wish she wasn't. It's not worth worrying about right now.」
「I've got my hands full just with the Independent Commando Unit. You're doing well to juggle them both at once.」
Hebiko opened her eyes wide in anger, but then she giggled.
I didn't know what that was about, but she was unusually amped up.
「So, where are we going now? It would be easy if we just went and arrested the culprit all of a sudden.」
「Aw, come on. It's not like that's going to happen, is it?」
「You still don't believe me at all, do you?」
「You doubt that there really are serial killings going on, yes?」
「That's why I'm going to show you the scene of the crime.」
The smiling face that Hebiko had had up until now completely changed, and her eyes looked a little disapproving.
Koro-senpai was also looking at me like she was surprised.
「Th-That's my nature, so I can't help it!」
「Koro-chan is surprisingly obliging towards him, huh?」
I asked Hebiko, since I was still the only one who didn't understand.
She was forming her mouth into a へ shape, but nevertheless explained for me.
「She's impressed, and says, “That's an essential quality in a detective.”」
「Hebiko thinks it's just Fuuma-chan being grumpy. There's no way it's a lie, is there?」
The three of them were having some kind of conversation.
It seemed like I was in a shaky position, so I just kept silent and followed behind them.
Also, en route to the “scene of the crime”, we happened to meet Shikanosuke at Inageya.
「I wondered where you disappeared to. You guys were together, huh?」
「I happened to run into Clear, and we've been shopping together.」
Clear trotted out from inside Inageya, an ice pop in hand.
It was a red-and-green one today.
She nodded, and held the ice pop out with a face that said, “Just one bite.”
「Thanks, but I'm fine for now. I have a little business to take care of.」
Clear started eating, as if she was glad I hadn't had a bite.
「What business? It looks like you're with some senpai I don't know.」
「It's a Public Order Unit mission, Shikanosuke-chan!」
「Public Order Unit? Why's Fuuma with you? Is he being taken away 'cause he did something?」
Clear stopped eating her ice pop and shot me a look. Scary.
「I didn't, I didn't! It's a murder case investigation, so they tell me. I'm a temporary member, and I'm helping with that.」
「Playing detective, huh?! Throw me in, too!」
Perhaps having misunderstood something, Shikanosuke leaned forward excitedly.
「Really?! Then, I'll be the great detective, and―――」
「No. This is a dangerous mission for a child.」
I could only hear one of them, but I could tell from the other's face that she had flatly refused.
「“Child”...... Calling me a child...... Even though I'm the same age as those guys......」
Shikanosuke was sulking, after being curtly cut off by both the cool beauty, Nao-senpai, and the plain beauty, Koro-senpai.
Paying no mind to the likes of Shikanosuke, the two senpais had started walking.
「Later, Shikanosuke. Don't feel bad. If anything, you're lucky not to get involved. No, really.」
「E-Even if you beg me to save you later, I won't care!」
Shikanosuke, meanwhile, was bitterly saying that.
While eating her ice pop, Clear patted Shikanosuke's shoulder to console him.
A largish Japanese-style house. It had the feel of an old family estate.
（As I recall, wasn't this the house of someone from the Igawa clan? Asai something or other......?）
Thinking that, I looked at the nameplate, and sure enough,  it read 『Asai』.
It was extremely quiet, and didn't seem like the scene of a murder.
No, was it too quiet for someone to be living here?
「The one who's gone missing is Asai Miori, second-year student.」
「That's a high-ranking Igawa clan ninja family, right?」
「Right. Miori's parents disappeared along with her.」
「Leaving behind massive bloodstains, enough to be a lethal amount for several people. That's why there's nobody in this house now.」
No wonder there was no sign of people.
「The Asai family disappearance case was the clue that made us realize there were serial killings.」
「More than twenty people may have been killed prior to this disappearance.」
「With so many murdered, how come you didn't realize it until now?」
Koro-senpai twitched, and then explained something to me, but as usual, I couldn't hear it.
Because of that, Hebiko translated for me again.
「She says until the Asai family were killed, the victims were all recorded as having died or disappeared from other causes.」
「With this case as the trigger, the past disappearances have been reinvestigated. By us, the Public Order Unit.」
「And, the first murder case dates back ten years ago.」
「I see. You're saying that even though you're calling them serial killings, that doesn't mean they occurred one after another over a short period.」
「Right. Up until now, they were being treated as isolated incidents.」
「But why would a criminal who's kept killing undetected for ten years do something so conspicuous all of a sudden?」
「All the victims prior to the Asai family case were women, and disappeared on their own.」
「The culprit appears to have become radicalized for some reason.」
I had been able to make out that quiet voice.
Was that because Koro-senpai's voice had gotten louder due to her silent anger towards the serial killer, or because I had finally gotten used to hearing her whispers?
「She says: They're provoking us, aren't they?」
「It's all right. I managed to hear that one.」
「Koro-senpai, could I ask you to speak about as loudly as you just did?」
It was a voice as thin as a mosquito's buzz, but I had just about caught that one, too.
「Now, shall I show you to the scene of the crime?」
Nao-senpai was just about to set foot on the mansion site, when―――
Koro-senpai stopped Nao-senpai by letting out what was most likely the loudest voice she could muster.
「（There are signs that someone has trespassed inside the premises.）」
「How can you tell that from here?」
「That's thanks to Koro-chan's Soul Escape Arts.」
「By Soul Escape Arts, you mean the techniques where you can read spiritual information by touching a dead body?」
「You're sure knowledgable. That's exactly right. She can sense not only genetic information and the cause of death, but even any strongly lingering thoughts.」
「But that's not all. Koro-chan can―――Eh? What?」
Koro-senpai had nudged Nao-senpai with her shoulder, looking displeased.
「（I was going to tell him myself.）」
「（I can sense signs not only of dead bodies, but living things as well. As traces of a soul travelling.）」
「（In other words, there are fresh signs of a new living thing. And a human being at that, not a bug or an animal.）」
「Serial killers often return to the scene of the crime.」
「That being the case, let's keep our guards up as we search the scene one more time.」
I answered, while looking at Hebiko like when she was in our usual unit.
She nodded, as if to say, 『I understand.』
And so, we were once again about to enter the premises, in the order of Nao-senpai, Koro-senpai and me, when
Having transformed into an octopus, Hebiko, who was normally in charge of scouting for enemies, had picked up something with her suction pad sensors.
The two from the Gosha Public Order Unit turned back in surprise.
「Maybe! They're coming!! There, and there, and there!!」
Hebiko swiftly pointed to the estate's garden.
Mud erupted from the ground, and transformed into countless humanoid monsters.
「They've finally shown up to eliminate us in person, huh?」
The mud golems opened holes which looked like mouths, let out strange roars, and attacked.
